EXCISE (SPECIAL PROVISIONS) ACT, No. 13 OF 1989
Order under Section 3

BY virtue of the powers vested in me by Section 3 of the Excise (Special Provisions) Act, No. 13 of 1989, I, RaviKarunanayake, Minister of Finance, do by this Order declare that, the Excise duty on every article specified in the ColumnsII and III of the Schedule hereto, corresponding to the every article specified under the following H. S. Headings mentionedin the Column I of the Schedule I of the Extraordinary Gazette Notification No. 1941/29 dated 20.11.2015 issued underthe Section 3 of this Act, shall be payable at the rate specified in the corresponding entry in Column IV of the Schedulehereto, with effect from 27.05.2016.
RAVI KARUNANAYAKE,
Minister of Finance.Ministry of Finance,Colombo 01,25th May 2016.
